title: We’re Sharing October Prime Day Discounts Live—Follow Along Here
gist: Wired's live blog for the last day of Amazon's October Prime Day, listing reviewer-picked discounts on consumer gadgets and household goods. Mostly promotional with little market signal beyond discount levels.

insights.claim: Amazon's October Prime Day (Big Deal Days) ran across two days, with Wired covering deals live on day two.
insights.speaker: WIRED
insights.so_what: Event timing marks the fall promotional window for consumer electronics demand.
insights.locator: It's the last day of Amazon Prime Day

insights.claim: Samsung's The Frame Pro (2026) art TV fell to $1,597 from $1,798 (11% off), the best price Wired has seen.
insights.speaker: WIRED
insights.so_what: Premium TV pricing is softening only modestly (11%).
insights.locator: The Best Art TV, Now At Its Lowest Price

insights.claim: Bose QuietComfort Headphones (1st Gen) dropped 53% to $169 from $359 as Bose launched the 2nd Gen model.
insights.speaker: WIRED
insights.so_what: Deep clearance discounts on prior-generation hardware follow new launches.

insights.claim: Roborock's Saros 20 robot vacuum was discounted 26% to $1,180, and the reviewer notes Roborock has released so many models this year that they are hard to review.
insights.speaker: WIRED
insights.so_what: Roborock's rapid SKU proliferation and discounting signal a competitive robot-vacuum market.
insights.locator: Get My Next Robot Vacuum Pick

insights.claim: Razer's Kraken Kitty V3 Pro fell 17% to $150, though the headset hit $100 earlier this year.
insights.speaker: WIRED
insights.so_what: Gaming peripherals have lower prices at other points in the year, so Prime Day is not always the floor.
insights.locator: The Iconic Razer Kitty Kraken Headset

insights.claim: Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro earbuds were on sale for the first time, at 20% off ($136 on Amazon from $170).
insights.speaker: WIRED
insights.so_what: Anker-brand audio is still holding full price until the first promotion.
insights.locator: I Call Mom More Because Of These Earbuds
